description: This file provides a fake implementation of the IHostApplicationLifetime interface for unit testing purposes. It manages cancellation tokens for application lifecycle events such as start, stopping, and stopped, allowing tests to simulate these lifecycle events.

classes.name: FakeHostApplicationLifetime
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IHostApplicationLifetime, providing controllable cancellation tokens for application lifecycle events in testing environments.

methods.name: StartApplication
methods.description: Signals that the application has started by cancelling the ApplicationStarted token.

methods.name: StopApplication
methods.description: Signals that the application is stopping and has stopped by cancelling the ApplicationStopping and ApplicationStopped tokens.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the internal CancellationTokenSource objects.
